name: TourDepartureManifestManager
tagline: Guarantee departures, build rooming lists and issue final documents – one app for every tour departure.
description: A complete tour-operations app as one PCF control: departure calendar, passenger manifests with min/max pax guarantee rules, go/no-go decisions with reasons, rooming split, dietary and mobility notes for suppliers, guide and coach assignment with double-booking detection and a final-documents checklist. Works instantly with demo data and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, collections or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Min/max pax guarantee rules and go/no-go date
Passenger status transitions with capacity and payment rules
Rooming split with drag & drop and keyboard pairing
Guide and coach timelines with double-booking detection
Final-documents checklist (payments, rooming, passports, guide, coach)
CSV export of manifests and rooming lists
Phone bottom navigation and card layouts
